_doc: EKF tuning for src/estimation (Track A). Units: m, rad unless the key says deg.
_P0_sd: start uncertainty (1 sigma): x [m], y [m], heading [deg] = how carefully the robot is placed by hand on the start spot (about +-10 cm, +-10 deg at 2 sigma). src/robot/scenario.py draws the true placement error from this same distribution, so the prior is honest by construction. Was 0.02 m / 2 deg: a start 11 cm off was then ~5 sigma out and the NIS gate rejected every correction (estimation_test).
_k_wheel: wheel distance noise: sd = k_wheel * |distance that wheel travelled| (6 % of the distance rolled); tuned in the evaluation, to be replaced by the UMBmark residual on the real robot
_range_sd: range sd = a + b * r^2 [m]: covers the ArUco range noise and bias in results/aruco_noise.csv
_range_bias_r2: ArUco range reads long by about 0.0055 * r^2 [m] (fit to range_bias_mm in results/aruco_noise.csv); subtracted before each update
_nis_gate: skip a marker when NIS > 13.8 = 99.9 % point of chi-square with 2 degrees of freedom
_max_frame_age: s; a camera frame older than this (vs the encoder time) is not fused
